subject: Compliance deck + SOC2 packet — quick check-in
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Holland <aholland@cortexloop.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance deck + SOC2 packet — quick check-in

Hi Alex — great to meet earlier today. Short recap and next steps from our discovery: 

- What we heard: CortexLoop needs predictable inference latency for customer-facing search (95th pctl under 250ms), auditability for data retention, and a deployment option inside your VPC.
- What Redwood offered: Hosted API for fast rollout + Private deployment for compliance, SOC 2 evidence and a recommended Dedicated pool for predictable SLAs.

I attached our SOC 2 packet and a one-pager on privacy controls. Could you confirm the reviewers on your side (security, procurement, infra)? If helpful, Ben can join a 30-min walkthrough with your security lead to step through the packet.

Next steps we proposed on the call:
1) I shared the SOC 2 packet (attached) — requested review by 5/10 so we can line up architecture and pricing.
2) Ben to scope Dedicated pool sizing after you confirm typical qps & average prompt lengths.
3) Marissa to send a preliminary mutual action plan (MAP) once procurement/infosec owners are clarified.

If timing has shifted or SOC 2 won't be the gating item, let me know and we can reprioritize.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai | (510) 555-0193

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_packet_2027.pdf (PDF, 2.3MB), redwood-privacy-factsheet.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Holland <aholland@cortexloop.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 09:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance deck + SOC2 packet — quick check-in

Alex — circling back on the SOC 2 packet I sent earlier this week. Wanted to make sure it landed with the right folks and check whether there are any immediate blockers from your security or procurement teams.

If a walkthrough would help, Ben is available Tue/Wed next week for a 30-minute session to go through controls, evidence locations, and audit timelines. Alternatively, if procurement prefers a redline-first approach, happy to engage legal — we can scope a clean contract path.

Quick ask: can you confirm who will own the review and an estimated completion date? Even a rough ETA helps us keep the MAP in sync.

Thanks — appreciate it,
Kim

Alex / procurement team — hope you had a good weekend. Quick nudge on the SOC 2 packet and the one-pager I shared. Two small asks so we can keep momentum:

2) If review will take longer, what timing should we plan against (new MAP target)? If the deployment priority has changed, just flag it and we can reprioritize accordingly.

If it's easier, we can do a 20-minute sync this week — I can share a focused agenda: "Key controls, evidence location, and integration checklist." Ben will cover technical fit and latency targets.

Thanks for the quick confirmation — I know these reviews get busy.

Cheers,
